run_evaluate_instructions: run the evaluate_instructions script to score LLM instructions on datasets like gsm8k or bbh
test_scorer_server: test the scorer server by calling text-bison or gpt models with a simple yes/no question
evaluate_single_instruction: evaluate a single instruction on a dataset fold using a scorer model and save accuracy results to CSV
create_result_directory: create a timestamped result directory under outputs/scorer-outputs for evaluation results
summarize_accuracy: summarize average accuracy percentages across training and test folds for each evaluated instruction
